items.name: Camp Club
items.description: A length of firewood somebody swung once and kept.

items.name: Jawbone Club
items.description: Something big died for this. It still bites.

items.name: Skull Cudgel
items.description: A goblin chieftain's answer to a mace.

items.name: Totem Bludgeon
items.description: Carved, feathered and far too heavy for the goblin who carried it.

items.name: Butcher's Cleaver
items.description: Kitchen steel put to worse use.

items.name: Rusted Chopper
items.description: The edge is mostly rust. Rust cuts too.

items.name: Scrap Shiv
items.description: Hammered from a broken sword and wrapped in cord.

items.name: Warcamp Hatchet
items.description: Notched, bound and swung by a dozen owners.

items.name: Bone Axe
items.description: A stone edge lashed to a thigh bone.

items.name: Scavenged Blade
items.description: Pulled off a battlefield and never cleaned.

items.name: Raid Cutlass
items.description: A goblin raider's pride: stolen, and sharp.

items.name: Chieftain's Sword
items.description: The one straight blade in the whole war camp.

items.name: Oar Club
items.description: Half an oar. The other half is still in the fjord.

items.name: Smith's Hammer
items.description: Meant for iron. Works on skulls.

items.name: Raider's Hammer
items.description: A short haft and a heavy head, made to be swung from a boat.

items.name: Thane's Mallet
items.description: Plain, balanced and unbreakable.

items.name: Fjord Sledge
items.description: Two hands' worth of iron, swung with one.

items.name: Bearded Axe
items.description: The classic Norse edge, hooked to pull a shield aside.

items.name: Hewing Axe
items.description: A woodsman's tool with a warrior's edge.

items.name: Dane Axe
items.description: A long haft and a wide blade. Reach nobody argues with.

items.name: Jarl's Sword
items.description: Pattern-welded steel, the kind that gets a name.

items.name: Squire's Sword
items.description: The first real blade a squire is trusted with.

items.name: Footman's Blade
items.description: Standard issue for the castle guard.

items.name: Arming Sword
items.description: A plain, honest sword. Thousands were made.

items.name: Watchman's Sword
items.description: Carried on the walls every cold night.

items.name: Kingsguard Longsword
items.description: Blued steel with the guard's red grip.

items.name: Castellan's Blade
items.description: Kept sharp by a man who rarely drew it.

items.name: Marshal's Longsword
items.description: A longer blade for a longer reach.

items.name: Bastard Sword
items.description: Long enough for two hands, light enough for one.

items.name: Short Sword
items.description: Quick to draw, quick to cut.

items.name: Tourney Blade
items.description: Won in the lists, kept for the war.

items.name: Chapel Sword
items.description: Blessed, or so the priest said.

items.name: Knight's Longsword
items.description: Gilded hilt, working edge.

items.name: Crusader's Longsword
items.description: Wide, heavy and tired of foreign sun.

items.name: Duelist's Sabre
items.description: Curved for the cut, quick in the hand.

items.name: Crimson Kingsblade
items.description: Red-edged steel from the king's own forge.

items.name: Heraldic Longsword
items.description: A house sigil worked into the guard.

items.name: Bloodoath Blade
items.description: Sworn on, bled on, never sheathed unpaid.

items.name: Vermilion Fang
items.description: A slim red blade for a fast hand.

items.name: Woodsman's Axe
items.description: Fells trees. Fells men.

items.name: Guard Axe
items.description: A long-hafted axe for the castle gate.

items.name: Twin-Bit Axe
items.description: Two edges so neither side of the swing is wasted.

items.name: Horned Axe
items.description: A wide crescent edge on a plain haft.

items.name: Kingsguard Axe
items.description: Red-wrapped and heavy at the head.

items.name: Reaver's Axe
items.description: Curved for pulling riders from saddles.

items.name: Broad Axe
items.description: As wide as it is honest.

items.name: Executioner's Axe
items.description: Only ever needs one swing.

items.name: Hand Axe
items.description: Small, quick and easy to throw. Don't.

items.name: Battle Axe
items.description: The soldier's axe, no ornament, no mercy.

items.name: Long Axe
items.description: A slim blade on the longest haft in the armory.

items.name: Rondel Dagger
items.description: A needle for finding gaps in plate.

items.name: Bollock Dagger
items.description: Everyone carries one. Few admit it.

items.name: Guard's Dagger
items.description: A wider blade with a proper crossguard.

items.name: Knight's Dirk
items.description: Kept for when the sword is lost.

items.name: Quillon Dagger
items.description: Plain steel, plain wood, sharp point.

items.name: Parrying Sword
items.description: Long for a dagger, short for a sword. Perfect for both.

items.name: Hunting Dagger
items.description: Made for boar. Boar are tougher than most men.

items.name: Kitchen Knife
items.description: Not a weapon. Tell that to the last cook.

items.name: Carving Knife
items.description: Long and thin and sharper than it should be.

items.name: Skinning Knife
items.description: A pale, narrow blade.

items.name: Paring Knife
items.description: Small enough to hide. Sharp enough to matter.

items.name: Warhammer
items.description: A square head and a spike. Plate means nothing.

items.name: Mason's Hammer
items.description: Builds castles. Unbuilds knights.

items.name: Horseman's Hammer
items.description: Light in the hand, hard on the helm.

items.name: Gate Maul
items.description: A long haft and a head like a doorstop.

items.name: Kingsguard Hammer
items.description: Red-wrapped haft, blued head.

items.name: Judgement
items.description: The royal executioner's hammer. Never rusts.

items.name: Flanged Mace
items.description: Iron flanges on a short haft.

items.name: Knight's Mace
items.description: A slender haft and a heavy round head.

items.name: Morning Star
items.description: Spikes on a ball on a stick. Simple. Awful.

items.name: Footman's Mace
items.description: Standard issue for breaking shields.

items.name: Chapel Mace
items.description: A priest's weapon: no edge, no sin.

items.name: Spiked Club
items.description: A club that met a blacksmith.

items.name: Iron Sceptre
items.description: An officer's baton with a rough crystal set in the head. The apprentice's focus.

items.name: Bishop's Sceptre
items.description: A jewelled cross-head on a dark shaft. It was blessed once, and it remembers.

items.name: Herald's Rod
items.description: A plain gold rod. Announces the bolt. Also concludes it.

items.name: Sceptre of the Crown
items.description: Gold cross, gold head, iron heart. The crown's own casting focus.

items.name: Sunburst Sceptre
items.description: The high priest's sceptre, gilded and blessed. The nova it casts is warm.

items.name: Steward's Rod
items.description: A brass orb on a plain handle for a plain office. Warm to hold before it fires.

items.name: Orb Sceptre
items.description: A spiked blue crystal on a red-wrapped shaft. The bolt comes out jagged.

items.name: Regent's Sceptre
items.description: A cluster of blue crystal carried in the king's absence. It frosts the hand.

items.name: Chancellor's Sceptre
items.description: A smooth blue sphere that does not reflect the torches. It reflects something else.

items.name: Knight's Broadsword
items.description: Wide, gilded and made for the charge.

items.name: Court Rapier
items.description: Thin as a lie and twice as quick.

items.name: Zweihander
items.description: A sword the height of a man. You will need both hands and all your nerve.

items.name: Deep Gladius
items.description: A stubby dwarven blade for tight tunnels.

items.name: Vault Shortsword
items.description: Bronze-hilted, from a sealed vault.

items.name: Miner's Sword
items.description: Sharpened on rock.

items.name: Tunnel Blade
items.description: Short, because the ceilings are.

items.name: Dwarven Shortsword
items.description: Thick spine, hard edge.

items.name: Delver's Sword
items.description: Standard kit for the deep roads.

items.name: Deep Longsword
items.description: Balanced for a dwarf, fine for anyone.

items.name: Vault Sabre
items.description: A curved blade with a bronze knuckle.

items.name: Ancestor's Sword
items.description: Older than the hall it was found in.

items.name: Ironroot Blade
items.description: A dark steel edge on a red grip.

items.name: Gilded Scimitar
items.description: Curved and gilded, a merchant-prince's blade.

items.name: Deep Falchion
items.description: One wide edge, bronze-backed.

items.name: Hooked Falchion
items.description: The point curls back to catch a guard.

items.name: Runeforged Sword
items.description: A long blade with veins of red rune-light.

items.name: Kinslayer
items.description: A dwarven king's sword, and the reason he was the last.

items.name: Hall Guard's Sword
items.description: The blade of the door-wardens of the deep.

items.name: Vault Greatsword
items.description: A long bronze blade from the treasure vaults.

items.name: Deep Claymore
items.description: A dark blade, longer than a dwarf is tall.

items.name: Ancestor's Greatsword
items.description: Cut from a hall-pillar's worth of steel.

items.name: Gilded Greatsword
items.description: Gold along the fuller, bronze at the guard.

items.name: Hooked Cleaver
items.description: Wide, curved and eager.

items.name: Delver's Greatsword
items.description: Long, plain and dependable.

items.name: Dark Iron Greatsword
items.description: Black steel that drinks the torchlight.

items.name: Long Falchion
items.description: A single heavy edge, bronze-backed.

items.name: Vault Scimitar
items.description: A wide curve of bright steel.

items.name: Mountainbreaker
items.description: The largest blade the deep forges ever cast. Rune-lit down its whole length.

items.name: Grave Warden
items.description: A sword left to guard a tomb. It still does.

items.name: Deep Hatchet
items.description: A dwarven hand axe.

items.name: Vault Axe
items.description: Bronze-edged, from the vaults.

items.name: Miner's Axe
items.description: Cuts timber props. Cuts more.

items.name: Delver's Axe
items.description: A wide blade on a short haft.

items.name: Tunnel Pick
items.description: Half pick, half axe, all business.

items.name: Ironroot Axe
items.description: A heavy head on a red-bound haft.

items.name: Hall Guard's Axe
items.description: A bearded axe with a spiked back.

items.name: Vault Battleaxe
items.description: Bronze and steel, made to hold a door.

items.name: Ancestor's Axe
items.description: The old pattern, still the best.

items.name: Deep Battleaxe
items.description: A tall blade for a tall swing.

items.name: Runeforged Axe
items.description: Red rune-light along the edge.

items.name: Dark Iron Axe
items.description: A double-edged head of black steel.

items.name: Delver's Battleaxe
items.description: A crescent edge and a long haft.

items.name: Deep Dirk
items.description: A long dwarven knife.

items.name: Gilded Kukri
items.description: A curved bronze blade from the vaults.

items.name: Curved Skinner
items.description: A hooked dwarven knife.

items.name: Belt Knife
items.description: Small and always there.

items.name: Deep Stiletto
items.description: A needle of dark steel.

items.name: Deep Warmace
items.description: A dwarven mace with a long reach.

items.name: Vault Mace
items.description: A bronze head, ribbed and heavy.

items.name: Ancestor's Maul
items.description: A twin-bladed head of dark steel and bronze.

items.name: Delver's Warmace
items.description: A long haft and a spiked crown.

items.name: Deep Mace
items.description: Compact and dwarf-forged.

items.name: Ribbed Mace
items.description: A bronze head with heavy ribs.

items.name: Spiked Warmace
items.description: A ball of spikes on a bronze haft.

items.name: Vault Warhammer
items.description: A square bronze head and a spike.

items.name: Deep Warhammer
items.description: Dark iron on a red-bound haft.

items.name: Ancestor's Warhammer
items.description: Twin-headed, old and unbroken.

items.name: Runeforged Maul
items.description: A spiked head lit from within.

items.name: Deep Hammer
items.description: A dwarven war hammer, short and fierce.

items.name: Vault Pick-Hammer
items.description: A hammer face and a pick back.

items.name: Runeblade
items.description: A fortress sword with a blade of living rune-light.

items.name: Warlord's Edge
items.description: The Warlord's own pattern: dark steel, bright rune.

items.name: Fortress Greatblade
items.description: A wide rune-lit blade with a hooked guard.

items.name: Rune Axe
items.description: A fortress axe, its edge lit with runes.

items.name: Horned Mace
items.description: A ram's skull on a spiked haft. The eyes glow.

items.name: Fortress Morningstar
items.description: A ball of iron spikes from the fortress armory.

items.name: Rune Hammer
items.description: A square rune-lit head on a bound haft.

items.name: Skull Club
items.description: Someone's skull on someone's femur.

items.name: Bone Saw
items.description: A great circular blade of teeth. Nobody knows what it was for.

items.name: Gilded Runeblade
items.description: A fortress sword with a blade of living rune-light. Gold-lit: the fortress kept these for its champions.

items.name: Gilded Warlord's Edge
items.description: The Warlord's own pattern: dark steel, bright rune. Gold-lit: the fortress kept these for its champions.

items.name: Gilded Fortress Greatblade
items.description: A wide rune-lit blade with a hooked guard. Gold-lit: the fortress kept these for its champions.

items.name: Gilded Rune Axe
items.description: A fortress axe, its edge lit with runes. Gold-lit: the fortress kept these for its champions.

items.name: Gilded Rune Hammer
items.description: A square rune-lit head on a bound haft. Gold-lit: the fortress kept these for its champions.

items.name: Emberblade
items.description: A Runeblade quenched in fire. The blade burns red.

items.name: Frostbrand
items.description: A Warlord's Edge cooled in the deep. The blade glows cold.

items.name: Prism Saber
items.description: A bright one-handed blade. Quick slashes, a heavy thrust and a steady guard.

items.name: Dusk Saber
items.description: An alternate palette for the same balanced sword. A different look, equal power.

items.name: Dawn Saber
items.description: The prism saber in the colors of first light.

items.name: Tide Saber
items.description: The prism saber in deep sea blues.

items.name: Verdant Saber
items.description: The prism saber in forest greens.

items.name: Yew Longbow
items.description: A plain stave of yew, waxed string. Every archer starts here.

items.name: Ranger Longbow
items.description: Bound grip and horn nocks. Made for long days in the treeline.

items.name: Warden Longbow
items.description: Carved limbs and a reinforced riser. It draws heavy and hits like it.

items.name: Horn Recurve
items.description: Short, curled limbs that snap back fast. Quick to draw in a corridor.

items.name: Steppe Recurve
items.description: Laminated horn and sinew. A rider's bow that never left the saddle.

items.name: Gilded Recurve
items.description: Gold inlay along both limbs. A noble's hunting bow, taken off a wall.

items.name: Ashen Recurve
items.description: Blackened limbs, silver tips. Strung the night the fortress fell.

items.name: Camp Shortbow
items.description: Goblin work: crooked, knotted and somehow accurate.

items.name: Warcamp Bow
items.description: Bone tips and a string of something you would rather not ask about.

items.name: Pride Bow
items.description: Bright limbs and a proud draw. Carried with the head up.

items.name: Kingdom Hunting Bow
items.description: From the royal hunt. Every stag in the forest knew this string.

items.name: Royal Warbow
items.description: The crown's own bow. Its arrows opened the siege and closed the war.

items.name: Deep Walking Staff
items.description: A miner's staff with a stone that hums when the tunnel is wrong.

items.name: Tunnel Rod
items.description: Iron-shod and plain. The bolt it throws is anything but.

items.name: Lantern Staff
items.description: A caged glow at the head. Lights the way and burns what stands in it.

items.name: Cog Staff
items.description: Dwarven gearwork wound tight around a crystal core.

items.name: Forge Staff
items.description: Still warm from the anvil it was quenched beside.

items.name: Deep King's Staff
items.description: The Forge Lord's sceptre. The mountain answers when it strikes the floor.

items.name: Rune Staff
items.description: Fortress runes cut into black iron. They glow before the bolt leaves.

items.name: Ember Staff
items.description: A coal that never went out, set in a shaft of scorched oak.

items.name: Frost Staff
items.description: Rimed even in the forge. The bolt arrives before the cold does.

items.name: Shaman Stick
items.description: Feathers, teeth and a skull. Goblin magic, such as it is.

items.name: Totem Staff
items.description: A war totem on a pole. The camp followed it into every fight.

items.name: Hedge Wizard's Staff
items.description: Gnarled wood and a cheap crystal. It works, mostly.

items.name: Acolyte Staff
items.description: Given to every student of the tower. Few keep it this long.

items.name: Court Mage Staff
items.description: Polished for the throne room. Sharp enough for the dungeon under it.

items.name: Sunstone Staff
items.description: A stone that holds the noon. The orb it casts bursts bright.

items.name: Archmage Staff
items.description: Three crystals in a crown of gold. It does not miss.

items.name: Kingdom Crown Staff
items.description: The staff the old king's wizard carried into the vault, and never carried out.

items.name: Hedge Recurve
items.description: Short limbs, plain grip. The bow a village keeps behind the door.

items.name: Bone-Tipped Recurve
items.description: Antler nocks and a leather-bound riser. Made by someone who hunted to eat.

items.name: Winged Recurve
items.description: Broad carved limbs that flare like wings. Loud to draw, louder to land.

items.name: Crescent Recurve
items.description: Deep-curled limbs shaped like a waning moon. Draws smooth to the ear.

items.name: Tawny Longbow
items.description: Sun-bleached yew with a red wrap. The tanner's son shot this for years.

items.name: Nightwood Longbow
items.description: Dark-stained limbs that vanish in a doorway. The string is the only pale thing on it.

items.name: Blackwarden Longbow
items.description: The Warden longbow reforged in black. Heavier draw, harder arrow.

items.name: Dune Recurve
items.description: Steppe laminate with a sand-and-blue wrap. Built for wind.

items.name: Wyrmscale Recurve
items.description: Green-scaled limbs banded in red gold. The one recurve every archer in the fortress has heard of.

items.name: Rose Pride Bow
items.description: Pink and violet along the limbs. A proud draw in the colors of dawn.

items.name: Twilight Pride Bow
items.description: Blue into purple, tip to tip. Every arrow leaves at dusk.

items.name: Violet Pride Bow
items.description: Deep purple with a glow at the tips. Carried with the head up.

items.name: Tide Pride Bow
items.description: Cyan and sea-blue, bright as a flag. Hard to miss and harder to dodge.

items.name: Rosewood Staff
items.description: A rose-carved head on a straight shaft. Pretty, and it hits.

items.name: Bishop's Staff
items.description: A gilt cross on a long pole. Blesses what it strikes, briefly.

items.name: Seer's Crook
items.description: A curled crook with a crystal in its hook. Sees the bolt land before it flies.

items.name: Quarterstaff
items.description: Plain oak, iron-shod. Every apprentice's first staff and some masters' last.

items.name: Frostwood Staff
items.description: The hedge wizard's staff wrapped in blue. The crystal runs cold.

items.name: Gilt Acolyte Staff
items.description: An acolyte staff dressed in gold thread for the high festival.

items.name: Azure Court Staff
items.description: Court mage's staff in the queen's blue. Polished for the throne room.

items.name: Goldstone Staff
items.description: A sunstone set in gold. The orb it casts bursts warm.

items.name: Sapphire Archmage Staff
items.description: Three blue crystals in a crown of silver. It does not miss.

items.name: Gilded Crown Staff
items.description: The crown staff remade in gold for a king who never got to carry it.

items.name: Ironshod Walking Staff
items.description: A miner's staff banded in black iron. The stone still hums.

items.name: Silver Tunnel Rod
items.description: A tunnel rod in polished silver. The bolt it throws is plain white light.

items.name: Iron Lantern Staff
items.description: A caged glow in dark iron. Lights the way and burns what stands in it.

items.name: Silver Cog Staff
items.description: Dwarven gearwork in bright silver, wound round a crystal core.

items.name: Cold Forge Staff
items.description: A forge staff quenched in iron and never reheated.

items.name: Silver King's Staff
items.description: The Deep King's sceptre in silver. The mountain answers a little quieter.

items.name: Azure Sceptre
items.description: The iron sceptre wrapped in the queen's blue. Runs colder than it looks.

items.name: Golden Sun Sceptre
items.description: The crown sceptre in full gold. Every bolt is a decree.

items.name: Blazing Star Sceptre
items.description: The orb sceptre gold-banded, the orb lit. The bolt comes out blazing.

items.name: Moonwood Bow
items.description: Pale wood cut under a full moon, a gem set in the riser. It hums on the draw.

items.name: Duskwood Bow
items.description: Moonwood stained the colour of the hour after sunset. The gem burns violet.

items.name: Sylvan Recurve
items.description: Curled limbs wound with living vine. It grew this shape.

items.name: Autumn Recurve
items.description: Sylvan wood turned red and gold. It sheds a leaf with every arrow.

items.name: Warden's Bow
items.description: The forest wardens' war bow, gilt at the tips. Its arrows do not lose height.

items.name: Starlight Bow
items.description: A warden's bow strung with something that is not string. It glows blue before it fires.

items.name: Crescent Staff
items.description: A silver crescent cradling a gem. The bolt leaves in an arc.

items.name: Moonrise Staff
items.description: The crescent staff with a blue moonstone. The nova it casts is silver.

items.name: Bough Staff
items.description: A forked branch, still green at the tips, with a gem caught in the fork.

items.name: Autumn Bough
items.description: The bough staff in red and gold. The leaves never fall.

items.name: Gravewarden Staff
items.description: Iron and bone on a grave-black shaft. Things stay down when it says so.

items.name: Bloodletter Staff
items.description: The gravewarden staff bound in red. The bolt it throws does not stop bleeding.

items.name: Druid's Staff
items.description: A gnarled branch with leaves and berries still on it. The forest lent it.

items.name: Thornwood Staff
items.description: A druid's staff gone to thorn. It draws blood from the hand and gives it back as bolts.

items.name: Wizard's Staff
items.description: A tall staff with a curled gold head. The one on every tower's coat of arms.

items.name: Grey Wizard's Staff
items.description: A wizard's staff worn grey by a long road. It has been to the mountain and back.

items.name: Gilded Sceptre
items.description: A long gold sceptre with a jewelled head. A king's, once; a caster's now.

items.name: Rose Sceptre
items.description: The gilded sceptre with a rose-red stone. The bolt comes out warm.

items.name: Apprentice Wand
items.description: A plain wand of pale wood. The first thing every caster is handed.

items.name: Hazel Wand
items.description: A hazel wand with a dark grip. Quick to point, quick to fire.
